name: Stephen P. VanDerhoef
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Stephen P. VanDerhoef attended law school and graduated from Seattle University School of Law in 1990. Stephen VanDerhoef began practicing law in 1990.

Stephen VanDerhoef is an attorney at Cairncross & Hempelmann, P.S., helping people with Business Litigation issues. Cairncross & Hempelmann, P.S. has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Stephen VanDerhoef was selected to Super Lawyers for 2001 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
